name: Manage Tasks
description: Your own scheduled tasks: what you will do unattended, and when. 'list' answers "what is my next task / what am I supposed to do?". 'add' schedules new work — use in_s for a delay ('in one hour' = in_s 3600), cron for anything recurring ('every 20 minutes' = */20 * * * *, 'every Monday at 9' = 0 9 * * 1, 'weekdays at 7:30' = 30 7 * * 1-5). 'update' changes the schedule or the text of an existing task, 'delete' cancels one. Tasks only run while your autonomous mode is on.

action.description: list = show your scheduled tasks; add = create one; update = change one; delete = cancel one

prompt.description: What to do when the task runs, written so your future self understands it without any other context. Required for 'add'.

cron.description: Recurring schedule, 5 cron fields 'minute hour day month weekday' (weekday 0=Sunday). Examples: '*/20 * * * *' every 20 minutes, '0 9 * * 1' Mondays at 09:00, '30 7 * * 1-5' weekdays at 07:30, '0 8 1 * *' the 1st of each month at 08:00.

in_s.description: One-off: run once after this many seconds from now (3600 = in one hour). Prefer this over 'at' for relative times.

at.description: One-off: run once at this ISO timestamp (e.g. '2026-07-30T18:15'). Only for a wall-clock time the user actually named; it must be in the future, and you do not reliably know the current time — prefer in_s.

task_id.description: Which task to update or delete, as shown by 'list'.
